ns2:course.label: Incompressible Flow
ns2:course.description: Equations of motion for incompressible flow, both inviscid and viscous; potential flow theory, inviscid airfoil theory: two- and three-dimensional, Navier-Stokes equations, laminar boundary layer and transition to turbulence. Prerequisite: CS 101; credit or concurrent registration in MATH 241 (formerly MATH 243) or MATH 380.
